title: Listings
description: Manage product and service listings for your tenant storefront.

help.title: About Listings
help.overview: A listing is a provider's service offer on the marketplace: what they do, in which category and place, at what price, with optional packages and add-ons. Buyers order from active listings. Status is draft, active, or inactive and is changed only by the activate and deactivate actions.

sections.title: Status
items: Draft is the default while the offer is being built. Nobody can order it.
Activate makes it orderable. It requires a price and a currency, because an order without a package is priced from them.
Deactivate takes it offline without deleting it. Resolving a report against it can also deactivate it.
Only the listing's provider, or an administrator, can activate or deactivate.

sections.title: What you configure
items: Title, description, category, tags, FAQs, and buyer requirements describe the offer. Category is a listing category, not a product category.
Pricing type is fixed or hourly. Price and currency are the base price; delivery days set the default due date of an order.
Main image is required; image and video galleries are optional.
Country, state, and city place the offer. City and category decide which task requests the provider is told about.
Provider is the user who sells it: yourself, or another user of the same company.

sections.title: How an order is priced from it
sections.body: A buyer orders an active listing, optionally with one package and any add-ons.
items: Without a package: the listing price and delivery days. With a package: the package's price and delivery days instead.
Each add-on adds its price and its extra delivery days. Add-ons must belong to this listing and use the order's currency.
A provider cannot order their own listing.

sections.title: Visibility and reputation
items: A running promotion (featured or sponsored) puts the listing first in the storefront's recommended sort for its dates.
Reviews on completed orders give the listing its average rating and review count.
Users can report a listing; administrators review reports under Listing flags.

sections.title: Who sees what
items: Administrators see and manage every listing in the company. Other users change only listings they provide.
Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored. Its packages and add-ons cannot be restored while the listing is deleted.
